column1: #mapping_set_title: OHEO mappings to HEO concepts, RHEO types and NCIt terms

#mapping_set_description: Mappings from OHEO terms to the Health Economics Ontology (HEO) concepts that explain them, to RHEO types that sit beside them and to NCIt terms. HEO concepts explain meanings; OHEO and RHEO classes classify kinds of things; so no row is an identity and none uses skos:exactMatch. skos:closeMatch is used only where the HEO concept is itself the same kind of informational or method artefact as the OHEO class (an instrument, an endpoint, a value set, a method, a design or a category); skos:relatedMatch where the two are different kinds, such as an aspect of health and the outcome domain heading for it, a summary measure and an estimate of it, or an organisation and its reference case; skos:broadMatch where the HEO concept is broader and skos:narrowMatch where it is narrower. Every HEO concept named is active in HEO 1.1.0 and PUBLISHED in the catalog export of 17 October 2026.

#comment: Written by src/build_oheo.py and drafted by Michelle Ashley with Claude. Every row is proposed; reviewer_id and reviewer_label are left empty for curator sign-off. Confidence is a house scale (0.95 close match to an NCIt term, 0.9 close match, 0.8 broad or narrow match, 0.7 related match).
